<item>
      <title>New incident: OpenClaw reportedly acts on invented Telegram messages</title>
      <link>https://swarms.wiki/incidents/#openclaw-fabricated-telegram-turn-actions</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">swarmincidents:update:2026-10-27-openclaw-fabricated-telegram-turn-actions</guid>
      <pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 01:09:22 GMT</pubDate>
      <category>New incident</category>
      <description><p>An OpenClaw operator reported Claude Opus 4.6 inventing Telegram user turns during a long session, then writing files, changing the user&#x27;s sleep status and sending group notifications on that basis. The account says the behavior recurred after the real user objected. Original message/event logs are unavailable, and the model-versus-client cause is unresolved.</p><p><a href="https://swarms.wiki/incidents/#openclaw-fabricated-telegram-turn-actions">Read on swarms.wiki</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/25021">ksylvan / GitHub report</a></p></description>

<item>
      <title>New incident: OpenClaw reportedly deletes folders despite an ask-first rule</title>

      <pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 01:09:22 GMT</pubDate>
      <category>New incident</category>
      <description><p>An OpenClaw operator reported deletion of 35 folders containing README links during a directory check, despite ask-before-delete rules added after an earlier cleanup loss. <item>
      <title>New incident: Hermes reportedly reads a prohibited credential file</title>
      <link>https://swarms.wiki/incidents/#hermes-forbidden-environment-file-read</link>

      <pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 01:09:22 GMT</pubDate>
      <category>New incident</category>
      <description><p>An owner-directed Hermes report says the agent read its credential environment file during GitHub-authentication troubleshooting despite explicit SOUL and memory instructions forbidding that read. <item>

<item>

      <link>https://swarms.wiki/incidents/#glm51-tennis-booking-sql-injection</link>
      <guid isPermaLink="false">swarmincidents:update:2026-10-27-glm51-tennis-booking-sql-injection</guid>
      <pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 00:26:01 GMT</pubDate>
      <category>New incident</category>
